Example Federal Credit Union Foundation awards community grants

ANYTOWN, ST, December 5, 2025 — The Example Federal Credit Union Foundation awarded $250,000 in grants to twelve local nonprofits this year.

Grants supported financial literacy programs that reached 3,100 students in 2025.
